workflow: Manual deployment steps for Kubernetes clusters
trigger: New application version or configuration change
current_workaround: Engineers manually run kubectl commands, update YAML files, and verify pod status
consequence: Deployment errors, rollback delays, and wasted engineering hours

workflow: Manual database schema migration and data synchronization
trigger: Schema changes or data model updates
current_workaround: Developers write custom SQL scripts, run them manually, and check for errors
consequence: Data inconsistency, migration failures, and production downtime

workflow: Manual synchronization of customer data between CRM and email marketing platform
trigger: New contact added or updated in CRM
current_workaround: Export CSV from CRM, import into email tool, deduplicate manually
consequence: Stale or duplicate contacts, missed email campaigns, compliance risk

workflow: Manual reconciliation of bank transactions with accounting software
trigger: End of month or weekly bank statement
current_workaround: Download bank CSV, manually match transactions in spreadsheet, adjust entries
consequence: Errors in financial reports, late reconciliations, audit issues

workflow: Manual generation of weekly status reports from multiple project management tools
trigger: End of sprint or weekly review
current_workaround: Copy data from Jira, Trello, and Asana into a Google Doc, format manually
consequence: Inconsistent reports, missed deadlines, wasted time
